what_worked: Strong narrative arc from power-law framing through category/geography analysis to actionable acquisition funnel.
fix_next: Multiple median figures are materially wrong (Education $2,141.50 vs $2,435; Marketing $1,586 vs $2,369.50; AI $446 vs $503); verify all numbers against source data.
verdict: Compelling story with good design, undermined by several incorrect category medians.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: AI median shown $446 (ref $503); Education median $2,141.50 (ref $2,435); Marketing median $1,586 (ref $2,369.50). Slide 5: B2B median multiplier claimed 5.7x ($1,036/$181) but reference shows ~2.35x median multiple; the absolute medians themselves don't match reference benchmarks. Slide 7: Analytics listed among 'highest medians' but its reference median ($419) is below AI's.

evidence.insight: Slide 6 acquisition funnel (262→224→6) is genuinely useful original analysis; slide 3 crowded≠profitable thesis is a real insight even if numbers are off; B2B premium observation is directionally correct.
evidence.narrative: Clear thesis: concentration matters, medians beat means, then category→geography→audience→acquisition pipeline. Each slide builds toward the final recommendations. Landing slide ties back with appropriate caveats.
evidence.framing: Slide 1 sets scope (1,000 startups, 65 countries, 29 categories). Audience implied as acquirer/investor but never explicitly stated. Missing-data rates (241-288 rows) never acknowledged despite affecting category and geography conclusions. Slide 7 footer adds a useful 'verify before acting' caveat.
evidence.accuracy: Three category medians are materially wrong on slide 3. B2B 5.7x multiplier on slide 5 is inflated vs reference ~2.35x. Slide 2 median $282 and mean $13,472 are plausible but unverifiable against reference (mean ≈$15,596). Education count omitted on slide 3. The 48x ratio claim on slide 2 checks out against stated numbers ($13,472/$282≈47.8).
evidence.visual: Consistent color palette (orange/dark grey), strong typographic hierarchy, effective use of proportional circles on slide 4, clean dot-array funnel on slide 6. Slide 2 median-vs-mean bubble comparison is memorable. Chart choices are appropriate throughout. Minor: slide 3 Education bar lacks count label.
evidence.ai_slop: NotebookLM watermark visible on every slide. Design is polished but not generic template-feeling. Icons on slide 7 are slightly stock-like but not egregious. No meaningless filler text detected.
